snippet.title: Venus in Transit Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming March 27,  2026.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4448670/Venus_in_Transit/

Venus in Transit is a short horror game inspired by Iron Lung. I made it in just under two months and it is releasing on March 27. This will be my first steam release! Whishlist now!
